usage: cli.py ingest-catalysts [-h] --prices PRICES --prices-meta PRICES_META
                               --filings FILINGS --filings-meta FILINGS_META
                               --out OUT [--meta-out META_OUT]
                               [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] [--cache-only]
                               [--refresh] [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prices PRICES       Path to prices CSV
  --prices-meta PRICES_META
                        Path to prices meta JSON
  --filings FILINGS     Path to filings JSONL
  --filings-meta FILINGS_META
                        Path to filings meta JSON
  --out OUT             Output catalysts JSONL path
  --meta-out META_OUT   Optional output metadata JSON path
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Cache directory for derived catalysts
  --cache-only          Fail if cache is missing; do not recompute.
  --refresh             Recompute even if cache exists.
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
